A submitted/under_review registration with partner_access=granted keeps 'granted' under the NEW partner; if admin later returns it for clarification, the new partner can get an edit-link (edit-link allows needs_clarification) without the supplier ever consenting to that partner. Consider resetting granted->awaiting_consent (or self_fill) for any non-approved status, or re-checking consent partner_id on edit-link.

Approved supplier whose partner access was revoked (vendor doc has no partner fields) can be reassigned; vendor doc then gets the new partner's code although registration access stays 'revoked' and deal commission for new partner returns 422 — inconsistent. Also withdrawn/declined registrations can be reassigned (no status guard).

Counts follow the CURRENT partner_id, so after a reassign the new partner gets credit for the old partner's approval and invite this month (draft reassign also resets partner_invited_at). Verified: after moving A's approved supplier to B, A shows 0/0 and B 1 approved/1 invite. Confirm this is intended; otherwise count from partner_history / original inviter.
